episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When a shocking mass shooting shatters Korea's calm, Lee Do races to stop the violence — then realizes the threat of illegal guns is just beginning.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As shootings spread, Lee Do discovers guns in the hands of everyday citizens. When a victim hits close to home, his investigation grows more urgent.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A police raid uncovers a cache of military weapons. Lee Do and his new ally Moon Baek close in on the arms network as the city reels from bloodshed.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Lee Do confronts a violent standoff and must decide how far to go to stop the killings, while suspicions about Moon Baek threaten their fragile alliance.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Guns reach bullied students and grieving parents, sparking new tragedies. Lee Do uncovers a network delivering weapons to vulnerable people across Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A gun in the hands of a student spells crisis at school. As panic spreads, Lee Do and Moon Baek race rush to restore order — but it may be too late.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: As fear and confusion grow, police and gangs rush to recover illegal guns. Lee Do feels powerless as the true scale of the arms crisis comes to light.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Police raid the gun syndicate, and rival gangs and old enemies clash in bloody battles. Lee Do is pushed to the limits as violence hits all of Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: When Moon Baek's message echoes through the media, guns reach new hands and fear takes hold. Across Korea, people must choose how to respond.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: With emotions running high, Lee Do and Moon Baek move toward a crossroads. One final choice will shape Korea's future — or plunge it into darkness.
